learning_data.name: What is Programming
learning_data.info: Programming is the process of writing computer programs. This is essential, as it allows you to make basically any program, game, software, etc. that you want. There are many different levels of programming, but we will just be looking at high-level programming this this case.

learning_data.name: Different Programming Languages
learning_data.info: In programming, there are many different types of computer programming languages that you can use to create different programs. They basically give people different ways or options of approaching different problem solving questions. Some are used to make websites, whilst others are used to make videogames, there is a very large variety of programs that can be created by all of them together

learning_data.name: How to Program
learning_data.info: The way to program for high-level languages is to use a sequence of keywords in order to create the rules that you program will follow and use throughout. We will explore the main componenets needed for building programs in all languages.

learning_data.name: Printing Details
learning_data.info: The easiest keyword to understand is print details. This will print line(s) of text out for you to read what has happened within the code.

learning_data.name: Variables
learning_data.info: Variables allow you to store data within a keyword of your choice. You can use this keyword at different other points in the program to perform tasks. These variables have a type attached to each, with the main types being string, integer, and boolean. A string variable will store a line of text, where as an integer variable will store a number value, and finally, the boolean variable will store either true or false, depending on what is it set to.

learning_data.name: If, Else
learning_data.info: An if statement allows you to select which code gets run, based off of a statement, say we wanted to check if a integer variable value was the number 0, we would say if variable = 0, then perform certain code. The else statement can only exist when the if statement does, as if the if condition is not met, then it will perform the code located in the else statement instead

learning_data.name: Remember
learning_data.info: Remember to keep in mind what each of these keywords do, as there will be a later section regarding this information
